verdict.rationale: Apple M5 comes with first-party developer documentation (Metal 4, Core ML, MLX, Foundation Models), so asking whether those docs are agent-consumable is a fair question. The probe of developer.apple.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing in the evidence shows an llms.txt file or any other agent-oriented documentation. The AI-performance claims are about running models on the chip, not about docs an agent can read.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
